# RBI keeps repo rate unchanged

The Monetary Policy Committee voted to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 5.50%, retaining a neutral stance. The standing deposit facility rate stays at 5.25% and the marginal standing facility rate at 5.75%. The committee projected CPI inflation for the year at 2.6% and real GDP growth at 6.8%.
